_doc: The flat (top-down) road camera at 36403cd, driven by the bot in core.js on the matrix in matrix.json with the vans in loadouts.json: the difficulty the angled drive is tuned to match (frozen: the flat camera is gone). Per cell (danger/day) and per route, each metric a trip mean with its sd and se (died: the share of trips the real van would not survive). Measured 2026-10-17 by the stage-1 baseline harness; see DESIGN.md "Balance".
